events.title: Demo patch 0.6.6
events.summary: Added a guard for a bug that blocks inputs and requires a restart to continue;added an option to attach game logs to a feedback report.If you happen to encounter the aforementioned bug, using the new feedback option should help me resolve it :)

events.title: Demo patch 0.6.4 & 0.6.5
events.summary: 0.6.4Fixed some problems with resolutions when playing in windowed mode;fixed a problem with the map appearing offset;artifact tooltips now correctly display all their information under the name (rarity ecc.).0.6.5Minor updates no longer clear your current run;fixed a bug where Renewal Orb could offer relics that shouldn't appear.

events.title: Demo patch 0.6.3
events.summary: Scythe and Drill artifacts now reveal cells instead of removing them;Decaying ground now removes 10% of board cells instead of 15%;Gambler class is now unlocked with 8 shop rerolls instead of 10;added a "None" option to unbind panning from the mouse buttons;added a dedicated, rebindable button to start panning;fixed prompts showing generic icons instead of the connected controller ones.

events.title: Demo released
events.summary: Hello everyone, the demo is finally available here on Steam! This version also includes Leaderboards for each class and difficulty 😊To any new players: Minato is a small game made by me, noshuio, in my free time, born to cope with my frustration at losing a long minesweeper board to a single mistake. It has grown beyond my initial expectations thanks to the community support and it'll be released here on Steam soon, shortly after the upcoming Steam Next Fest. It'll be priced at $2.99 with a 10%
